title: Visit recency and the Prescriptions & Renewals retail fill visit allowance
content:
Patient Services Center desk guidance — Prescriptions & Renewals.

**Rule.** When a patient moves a prescription to a retail pharmacy, the visit allowance follows the calendar days from the patient's latest completed in-person visit with the prescribing department to the day of the move, a virtual visit not counting: 183 days or fewer allows 90 days; more than 183 but no more than 365 days allows 60 days; more than 365 days, or no such visit, allows the retail standard of 30 days.

**Which visit counts.** The visit is taken from the patient's In-Person Appointments: the latest appointment recorded as completed whose department is the department of the prescriber on this prescription. A Virtual Care visit does not count, and neither does a booked, confirmed, cancelled or missed appointment, nor a completed visit with another department.

**Figures and their edges.**

| Calendar days since that visit | Visit allowance |
|---|---|
| 183 or fewer | 90 days |
| 184 to 365 | 60 days |
| 366 or more | 30 days |
| no completed in-person visit with that department | 30 days |

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Latest completed in-person visit with the prescribing department 183 days before the move: 90 days. At 184 days: 60 days.
- Latest completed in-person visit 365 days before: 60 days. At 366 days: 30 days.
- The patient's only visit with the department in the past year was a Virtual Care video visit, and the last completed in-person visit was 400 days ago: 30 days.
